single.rationale: NGS demonstrates compelling operational momentum with strong revenue growth (10% YoY, 27% 3-year CAGR), expanding operating margins (22%), and improving horsepower utilization (85%) driven by Permian Basin oil production. The company is investing heavily in fleet expansion (capex exceeding operating cash flow) while initiating dividends, though elevated capital intensity and negative free cash flow warrant deeper analysis of returns and sustainability.
